name: What are the benefits of having a general contractor oversee all bathroom trades?

mainEntity.name: What are the benefits of having a general contractor oversee all bathroom trades?

acceptedAnswer.text: A single point of contact oversees the entire renovation, managing demolition, framing, tile, finish carpentry, and paint while coordinating licensed plumbing and electrical trades. This model eliminates the hassle of homeowner-managed scheduling conflicts between separate contractors. The lead contractor ensures that plumbing rough-ins match exact vanity dimensions and that shower valve heights align with tile layouts before walls are closed up. Having one accountable professional on-site maintains consistent craftsmanship, clear communication, and efficient problem-solving from tear-out to final trim.
acceptedAnswer.description: A general contractor coordinates framing, tile, drywall, paint, and mechanical trades under one point of contact, ensuring proper alignment and schedule control.
